dedupe_keys.name: a global intra city commuting origin destination flow dataset for urban sustainable development

description: A Global Intra-city Commuting Origin-Destination Flow Dataset for Urban Sustainable Development is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Can Rong et al. Commuting Origin-Destination (OD) flows capture movements of people from residences to workplaces, representing the predominant form of intra-city mobility and serving as a critical reference for understanding urban dynamics and supporting sustainable policies. However, acquiring such data requires costly, time-consuming censuses. Coverage: global; published in 2026. Formats: Shapefile, Image, Python. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 9636699448 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
